hero.headlineHtml: Set it up once. Every app runs on it.
hero.lede: Your CRM, supplier accounts, payroll, call recordings and team live in one place. Costing, Follow-Up and Warehouse all work from the same jobs and customers.

sections.title: Connect Each Tool One Time
sections.lede: Connections live on the platform, and every app reads the same jobs and customers. Turn on another app later and there's nothing new to connect.

items.title: Your CRM
items.body: Jobs, customers and estimates sync once and reach every app.

items.title: Supplier Accounts
items.body: Connect by API, with your portal login, or by forwarding emails. Invoices land on job costs and shipments land in Warehouse.

items.title: Payroll
items.body: Labor payments sync daily or come in from a report upload, then cost against jobs in Costing.

items.title: Call Recordings
items.body: Recorded sales calls sync daily. Follow-Up reads the call summary when it drafts a message.

items.title: Daily Sync, Plus a Button
items.body: API and portal connections sync each day on their own. Forwarded emails come in as they arrive. Hit Sync when you can't wait.

items.title: Finish Supplier Sign-Ins Here
items.body: When a supplier portal asks for a one-time code, the connection waits for you and you finish signing in from Kickback.

sections.title: One Supplier Account Feeds Two Apps
sections.body: Connect Associated Materials or Wincore once and both Costing and Warehouse use it. Costing gets the invoices. Warehouse gets the load manifests and puts each truck on the books.

bullets.title: Two Addresses, One Connection
bullets.text: Each supplier connection gets an invoice address for Costing and a manifest address for Warehouse. Copy them from the vendor page.

bullets.title: See What Each Supplier Feeds
bullets.text: The vendor list marks every supplier with the apps it serves.

bullets.title: Replace a Leaked Address
bullets.text: Make a new one and anything mailed to the old address bounces.

sections.title: Give Each Person the Apps They Use
sections.body: Invite people by email and switch on the apps each one needs. They get a link to join, and they only see the apps you turned on.

bullets.title: Sub-Roles Inside Each App
bullets.text: Cadence Editor in Follow-Up. Device, Location and Stock Manager in Warehouse.

bullets.title: Billing and Integrations Roles
bullets.text: Let someone manage the subscription or connect suppliers without making them an owner.

bullets.title: Audit Log
bullets.text: Owners see every change in the organization, with who made it, when, and the before and after values.

sections.title: Passkeys and Two-Factor Codes
sections.body: Each person picks how they sign in. A passkey uses Touch ID, Face ID or Windows Hello. An authenticator app adds a 6-digit code to every password sign-in. A linked Google, Microsoft or Apple account works too.

bullets.title: Backup Codes
bullets.text: Five single-use codes for the day someone loses their phone.

bullets.title: Account Lockout
bullets.text: Ten wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.

bullets.title: Encrypted Credentials
bullets.text: Supplier passwords and API keys are encrypted at rest and never shown again after you save them.

sections.title: Hear About What Needs You
sections.body: Every alert lands in the notification center. Each person turns push and email on or off per alert, and each app sends its own daily digest at the hour an owner picks.

bullets.title: Costing
bullets.text: A daily list of invoices auto-match applied, ready to review. Days with none send nothing.

bullets.title: Follow-Up
bullets.text: Each rep hears when drafts are ready. Owners get a daily list of follow-ups still open.

bullets.title: Warehouse
bullets.text: Pushes when a truck is loaded, arrives or closes, and when a job's material is staged. The daily digest lists trucks still being scanned in.

sections.title: Kickback on Your iPhone
sections.body: Kickback Platform is on the App Store. Switch between your apps, tap a push to land on the right screen, and work the Follow-Up outbox from your phone.

bullets.title: iPhone
bullets.text: Search for Kickback Platform on the App Store and sign in with your Kickback account.

cta.title: Put Your Whole Team on One Login
cta.body: If it's a fit, Kickback sets up your account and sends you the invite.
